high_level_description: This image is the cover of a Vogue magazine from November, priced at $3.00. The cover features a woman with long, wavy blonde hair, smiling brightly. She is wearing a black top with a large, ornate cross adorned with colorful gemstones on the front. The cross is prominently displayed across her chest. She is also wearing stonewashed Guess jeans. The background appears to be an outdoor setting, possibly near water, as there is a blurred view that suggests a body of water and some structures in the distance.
